plug_ins.selected_value: 7.2 read as 7.2% (0.072); all values divided by 100
plug_ins.justification: Values range -2.6 to 9.3; as decimals they would imply changes of several hundred percent, which is implausible for annual renewal rate changes.
plug_ins.limitation: Wrong only if the sheet uses a different convention, which is unlikely.

plug_ins.selected_value: Treated as achieved changes applying uniformly to all GC and LS earned premium
plug_ins.justification: The sheet notes it reflects cancellations, additional premium and GC/LS shifts, which suggests an achieved-type measure.
plug_ins.limitation: If these are filed/manual changes, achieved levels may differ and the OLFs (31% for 2014 down to 4% for 2024) could be overstated or understated.

plug_ins.missing_input: Loss and premium basis (gross vs ceded, subject vs treaty)
plug_ins.selected_value: 100% ground-up gross subject loss + ALAE over gross subject earned premium
plug_ins.justification: The triangle sheet is titled 'Ground-Up Loss Triangles' and its premium equals the subject earned premium. For a proportional quota share the ceded share cancels out of the loss ratio.
plug_ins.limitation: Ceding commission, brokerage and any treaty caps or corridors are not reflected; this is a subject-business loss ratio, not a technical treaty ratio.

plug_ins.selected_value: 1 Jul 2025 (same as loss trend), from 1 Jul of each CY
plug_ins.justification: Keeps premium and loss on the same 2025 cost level; you specified 1 Jul 2025 for losses.
plug_ins.limitation: The rate level target (end of PY 2025) and the trend date are not identical; this makes little difference.

plug_ins.missing_input: Whether exposure trend double counts rate changes (follow-up answer 6: 'no')
plug_ins.selected_value: Exposure trend applied to on-level premium as originally requested
plug_ins.justification: Your original request explicitly asked for trended and on-level premium using the stated exposure trends.
plug_ins.limitation: If the exposure base does not grow with inflation separately from rates, trended premium is overstated by 3% (2024) to 32% (2014) and adjusted loss ratios are understated.

plug_ins.missing_input: Maturity weights between CL and BF by AY
plug_ins.selected_value: CL weight = percent reported (1/CDF); BF weight = 1 - percent reported
plug_ins.justification: A transparent, maturity-driven credibility: the more developed the year, the more its own Chain Ladder indication is trusted.
plug_ins.limitation: Because BF already blends actual and prior by percent reported, this double-weights maturity (Benktander-like); the effect is only material for AY 2022-2024.

plug_ins.missing_input: Years included in the overall loss ratio
plug_ins.selected_value: Base: AY 2015-2024 weighted by trended on-level EP; AY 2014 excluded; 2018-2019 retained in base but removed in a sensitivity
plug_ins.justification: CY 2014 earned premium is less than half of TY 2014 written premium (ramp-up year) and its 149% adjusted LR rests on a thin premium base.
plug_ins.limitation: Excluding 2014 lowers the indication by about 2.5 points; the selection remains your call.
